parser_controls.scope: One duplicate-key probe; not a general strict JSON validator

identity.contract: 3600 frozen requests from captured path/hash; answers are positionally paired and do not carry an id field. Length, request.id and op are compared; exact Fraction values/enclosures are computed per request.
identity.limit: No claim that the answer protocol has an independently echoed request ID or that valid numerically identical rows are distinguishable.

targeted_causes.all_ambiguous_unchanged_intervals: Rejected before floors as an unnecessary ambiguous state.
targeted_causes.all_ambiguous_broad_valid_enclosures: Rejected exactly by non-vacuity floors, not a containment failure; all queries used finite broad enclosures and no useful classifications.
targeted_causes.bitwise_translation_mutation: A widened but still containing rho interval on a translated image is rejected exactly by translation changes native bits.

allowed_scope_probes.name: request_boolean_zero_id
allowed_scope_probes.scope: Malformed trusted request typing, not a forged output certificate; requests are separately hash-pinned.

allowed_scope_probes.name: removed_one_contact_marker
allowed_scope_probes.observed: Accepted: contact count196 becomes195, still above100.
allowed_scope_probes.scope: The marker belongs to the frozen request panel. Even without it, exact-distance and strict status tests still forbid an interior/exterior classification of a true contact. Not an exact manifest/fixture validator.

allowed_scope_probes.name: unused_extra_nonfinite_field
allowed_scope_probes.observed: Accepted: an in-memory NaN in an unknown unused answer field is ignored.
allowed_scope_probes.scope: All numeric certificate fields remain checked finite through interval bits. Do not describe this judge as rejecting every nonfinite JSON value or every unknown field.

scope: Imported original judge and altered data only in memory; no native execution, engine validation, GPU/GCP, global nearest/index/FULL qualification or statistical robustness.
normal_optimized: Same complete results after removing only optimize_flag (0 versus1).
